promise: Zuckerberg said Facebook was expanding safety and security staffing from 10,000 to 20,000 during 2018.
description: Zuckerberg reiterated the safety and security staffing target in September 2018. Facebook's December 4 update reported more than 30,000 people in these teams, including contractors and partner-company reviewers.
evidence: The September 28 press-call transcript records the staffing target.
Facebook's December 4, 2018 update reports safety and security staffing above 30,000. The measure includes employees, contractors and partner-company staff, not only payroll headcount.

person: Moon Jae-in and Kim Jong Un
role: Leaders of South Korea and North Korea
promise: The Panmunjom Declaration called for declaring an end to the Korean War during 2018 and pursuing a peace agreement.
description: The leaders signed the joint declaration on April 27, 2018.
evidence: The official declaration supports the signatories, date and 2018 objective.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked declaration does not document a subsequent end-of-war agreement.
sources: South Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs

promise: Harry Potter: Wizards Unite (announced Nov 2017) to launch in 2018
description: Game launched June 21, 2019 (a year late) and was shut down in January 2022 after disappointing performance.
evidence: Retained from the existing collection; outcome evidence remains to be documented.

review.note: Niantic records April/May 2019 regional beta, demonstrating availability before purported June launch. Original November 2017/2018 target and exact public launch need sources. June 30 original date impossible for November announcement; 'one year late' overstates June versus December miss.

promise: IPCC agreed to provide a special report in 2018 on 1.5-degree global warming and related emissions pathways.
description: IPCC announced its acceptance of the request on April 14, 2016. It publicly released the special report on October 8, 2018, within the requested year.
evidence: IPCC's April 2016 release specifies the 2018 workplan.

promise: GE would earn $2 per share in operating earnings by 2018
description: GE reported adjusted earnings of $0.65 per share for 2018 and a GAAP continuing-operations loss of $2.43 per share. The adjusted result was below the cited $2 ambition; the accounting measures should be identified explicitly.
evidence: GE reported a net loss in 2018 and adjusted EPS far below the $2 target
GE cut its dividend and was dropped from the Dow in 2018

review.note: 2018 adjusted EPS of $0.65 is below $2; GAAP continuing EPS was negative $2.43. Do not mix these measures. The exact May 20 announcement and comparability of original operating-EPS definition require further evidence.

promise: Prime Air would deliver packages by drone in 30 minutes or less, starting within four to five years
description: Bezos described drone deliveries as potentially four or five years away, subject to regulatory approval, in an interview broadcast on the US evening of December 1, 2013. Amazon conducted a small UK customer-delivery trial in December 2016; a trial is not a broad commercial rollout.
evidence: No commercial Prime Air deliveries by 2018; AP reported the blown deadline in December 2018
Limited drone trials began only in 2022-2024

review.note: The four-to-five-year statement was an estimate conditioned on regulation, not a guaranteed nationwide launch. The December 1 evening US broadcast fell on December 2 UTC. A December 7, 2016 UK customer trial contradicts the claim trials only began in 2022; distinguish trials from scaled service. Exact elapsed deadline should not be silently rounded to end-2018.

promise: Become the world's largest automaker by 2018 (Strategy 2018)
description: Volkswagen's 2015 annual report says Strategy 2018 launched in 2008 and included a target exceeding ten million annual vehicle sales. VW delivered about 10.3 million vehicles in 2016 and surpassed Toyota in volume. This supports the sales-ranking milestone, not fulfillment of every element of the strategy.
evidence: VW became the world's best-selling automaker in 2016 (10.3M vs Toyota 10.2M vehicles)
VW retained the top spot in 2017, ahead of the 2018 deadline

review.note: VW's own report dates the strategy launch to 2008, contradicting January 1, 2007. Sales leadership in 2016 is supported, but no exact replacement launch date was established; do not invent January 1, 2008. Broad Strategy 2018 included profitability and quality goals beyond volume.
